entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: Farthest planet orbiting the supervoid Sothera in the Edge, a titanic gas giant ringed by dozens of moons, with a secret research installation at its core.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Supervoid in the Edge that Uthros orbits.

entities.name: Uthros Combine
entities.description: Group that built a research complex as cover for a secret installation at Uthros's core.

entities.name: Illvoi
entities.description: People who call the corpse in the core a deity and a world-eater.

entities.name: Titan corpse of Uthros
entities.description: Corpse of a possibly eldrazi titan in the core, causing titanic elemental storms.

entities.name: Memory Vessel
entities.description: Ancient relic through which all Uthros networks are routed, converting data into thought.

events.summary: The Uthros Combine builds a research complex as cover for a secret installation at the planet's core, where a possible eldrazi titan's corpse has been studied for about 92 years.
events.quote: It has been studied for at least 33,507 cycles

relations.quote: the farthest planet orbiting to the supervoid Sothera in the Edge

relations.note: studies it in a secret installation
relations.quote: a secret research installation at the planet's core
